paragraphs: May and Pat walk to the park on Sunday. Pat has a comic in his hand. "I like lions," he says. "A lion is my favorite animal." May looks at the comic. "I don't like comics," she says. "I like music." "Do you like lions?" asks Pat. "I like them a little," says May.

Then they listen, and there is a loud noise. It is the school band! Ben is in the band, and he plays a big guitar. "I love it!" says May. But Pat puts his hands on his ears. "I don't like loud noise," he says. He wants to hide behind May. "Don't be afraid," says May. "It's only music." "Come with me." Pat says no, and he holds her hand.

Then a small kitten runs to them. It is orange, and it has big green eyes. It plays with a leaf on the ground. The kitten jumps and catches the leaf. Pat is not afraid now, and he laughs. "A kitten is a small lion!" he says. May laughs, too. "Can we take it home?" asks Pat. "Now I like lions a lot," she says. Pat puts the comic in his bag. He holds the kitten with both hands.
